summary: Independent fresh-context review (bergen-reviewer-PXD003338-r2) found no blocker or important issues. Channel-to-time-point mapping matches the deposited result table headers; design (one TMT10-plex, triplicates day 0/17, duplicates day 5/12, 12 hpH-RP fractions) matches the paper; raw-header sample IDs, vial positions and acquisition timestamps support the two 12-fraction injection series plus one re-injection of T2 fraction 10; all controlled terms resolve in live OLS; parse_sdrf passes for all three declared templates. Two tool flags (sdrf-tools check on the free-text in-house cell line, sdrf-tools reconcile on Trypsin) were adjudicated as false positives against the paper and the cell-lines guidance. Remaining findings are minor.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent context without producer transcript or report.md; all PRIDE, raw-header, result-table, BioC/PMC and Cellosaurus evidence re-fetched into scratchpad/PXD003338/review-PXD003338 (r2_* files and r2raw/) with accession/title identity asserted

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates declared: ms-proteomics v1.1.0, human v1.1.0, cell-lines v1.1.0; independently derived as correct (human iPSC-derived cultures, MS proteomics; cell-lines requires technology + sample layers, both present). 250 rows x 44 columns, uniform width, no leading/trailing whitespace, no duplicate assay names, no duplicate (data file, label) pairs. All required columns of base, sample-metadata, ms-proteomics, human and cell-lines present; reserved words used only where allowed (organism part 'not applicable'; cellosaurus accession/name 'not available', both allow_not_available=true). sampling time '0 day' etc. match number_with_unit; age '69Y' matches human pattern; collision energy '35% NCE' and ms1 scan range '400m/z-1400m/z' pass validators. sdrf-tools structure: 'Structure OK'.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Live OLS4 term lookups (label, not obsolete): NCBITaxon:9606 Homo sapiens; CL:0002248 pluripotent stem cell; CL:0000223 endodermal cell; PATO:0000461 normal; HANCESTRO:0005 European ancestry; UBERON:0002427 arm skin; MS:1002416 Orbitrap Fusion; MS:1001251 Trypsin; MS:1001309 Lys-C; MS:1000133 collision-induced dissociation; MS:1000264 ion trap; PRIDE:0000627 Data-dependent acquisition; PRIDE:0000564 High-pH reversed-phase chromatography (hpHRP); PRIDE:0000609 TCEP; PRIDE:0000599 Iodoacetamide (IAA); UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl; UNIMOD:737 TMT6plex (correct for TMT10plex); UNIMOD:35 Oxidation. All ten labels TMT126..TMT131 resolve to PRIDE:0000516-0000529. CL has no definitive-endoderm, foregut-endoderm or pancreatic-progenitor cell class (OLS search returned only hepatoblast / endocrine-pancreas progenitor), so the broader 'endodermal cell' is accurate rather than over-specific. The only non-ontology value is characteristics[cell line] 'AG16102-derived hiPSC' (see minor finding).

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE project (accession/title asserted PXD003338): Orbitrap Fusion, TMT, search settings (carbamidomethyl C, TMT N-term+K fixed, Met oxidation variable, 10 ppm / 0.5 Da, trypsin). Paper (PMC7289403 BioC, title asserted): AG16102 Coriell control fibroblasts reprogrammed in-house; triplicates day 0/17, duplicates day 5/12; one TMT10-plex; LysC 1:100 3 h then trypsin 1:50 overnight; TCEP / iodoacetamide; basic-pH RP, 96 -> 12 fractions; ~5 ug per fraction dissolved, ~1 ug per analysis (supports repeated injections); MS1 400-1400 m/z, CID NCE 35 ion-trap MS2, HCD 55 Orbitrap MS3; TopSpeed DDA. Deposited all_protein_identifications.xlsx (re-downloaded) ratio headers: Day 0 TMT 126/127C/127N, Day 5 128C/128N, Day 12 129C/129N, Day 17 130C/130N/131 - exactly matches SDRF label->sampling time/cell type mapping; sheet name 't1_and_t2_all_search_engines_pr' supports T1 and T2 being searched together. Cellosaurus CVCL_2G48 (AG16102): male, 69Y, Population Caucasian, arm skin UBERON:0002427, no disease - matches sex/age/ancestry/sampling site/disease. sdrf-tools reconcile flagged Trypsin as unsupported by the deposit record; adjudicated as false positive because the paper Methods explicitly describe trypsin digestion.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE /files: 26 RAW + 1 SEARCH xlsx, all projectAccessions PXD003338. SDRF references 25 RAW files, all present in PRIDE, each with exactly 10 rows (one per TMT channel). Only m03515.raw is unannotated (disclosed limitation; see minor finding). Re-fetched raw headers (first 256 KiB): m03490-m03501 sample IDs hv_0016_T1..hv_0027_T1, vials C5-D8, acquired consecutively 2014-11-22 20:48 to 2014-11-24 15:30; m03503-m03514 hv_0028_T2..hv_0039_T2, vials B1-C4, 2014-11-24 16:23 to 2014-11-26 11:09; m03545 hv_0037_T2 (same ID as m03512), vial A8, 2014-11-29; all same SPS-MS3 method. SDRF technical replicate / fraction coding (T1=1, T2=2, fractions in sequence order; m03545 = technical replicate 3, fraction 10) is consistent with this evidence.

design_consistency.evidence: 10 source names, one per TMT channel, each mapped to a single label, cell type, sampling time and biological replicate across all 25 files. Counts recomputed: day 0 = 3 samples (75 rows), day 5 = 2 (50), day 12 = 2 (50), day 17 = 3 (75), matching the paper. Fractions 1-12 in technical replicates 1 and 2 (120 rows each) plus technical replicate 3 for fraction 10 only (10 rows). factor value[sampling time] equals characteristics[sampling time] on every row. Cell type co-varies with time point by design (differentiation course), not a hidden confounder. Single individual / single line, as stated in the paper.

omission_safety.evidence: Every non-trivial value traced to PRIDE, the paper, the deposited result table, raw headers or Cellosaurus. No value is more specific than evidence: cell type for days 5-17 deliberately broad; cellosaurus accession/name 'not available' rather than borrowing CVCL_2G48 (parental fibroblast) or CVCL_B5PL (Coriell AG28269 iPSC, created 2022, no link to this study); m03515.raw left out instead of guessing its content; PRIDE 'diabetes mellitus' and 'pancreas' correctly not propagated as donor disease / organism part. Inferences (technical-replicate interpretation of T1/T2, within-series fraction order, arbitrary biological-replicate numbering, m03545 coding) are disclosed in the manifest limitations and supported by raw metadata.

findings.location: file-level: PRIDE file m03515.raw (not in comment[data file])
findings.message: One deposited RAW file is not annotated. Its raw-header sample ID is hv_0040_pg (vial C5, same method, acquired 2014-11-26 11:09 directly after T2 fraction 12, 194 MB vs ~390 MB for fractions). Its content is not described in the paper or deposit, so omission is the evidence-safe choice and is disclosed in the manifest limitations.
findings.evidence: PRIDE /files lists 26 RAW; SDRF covers 25. Correction criterion: annotate only if the submitters or a deposited search configuration identify what hv_0040_pg contains.

findings.message: 'AG16102-derived hiPSC' is a descriptive label, not a catalogued name, which triggers a cell-lines ontology warning and a sdrf-tools check 'hallucinated' flag. The paper does not name the proteomics line (the validation line is named iAGb), and the column forbids reserved words, so no better value is available.
findings.evidence: parse_sdrf cell-lines WARNING; Cellosaurus search for AG16102 children returns only AG28269 (CVCL_B5PL), with no link to this study. Correction criterion: replace with the lab's line name if the authors provide it.

findings.location: comment[technical replicate], comment[fraction identifier], all rows
findings.message: Treating T1/T2 as two injection series of the same 12 fractions, and assigning fraction numbers by sample-ID order, is inference. It is well supported (paper: one 10-plex, 12 fractions, ~5 ug dissolved and ~1 ug per analysis; sequential sample IDs, vials and timestamps; T1 and T2 searched together; m03545 repeats the hv_0037_T2 ID), but no deposited fraction table confirms it.
findings.evidence: Raw headers (r2raw/), xlsx sheet name; limitation disclosed in the evidence manifest.

findings.message: Recommended cell-lines columns (passage number, culture medium, sample storage temperature) and characteristics[developmental stage] are absent. The MS3 HCD (NCE 55) reporter-ion step is not represented alongside the CID MS2 settings. None of these are required.
findings.evidence: cell-lines.yaml marks passage number / culture medium / sample storage temperature as recommended; sdrf-tools score lists developmental stage as missing recommended; paper Methods describe HCD 55 MS3.

findings.message: The donor is identified by the Coriell fibroblast line ID AG16102. Cellosaurus shows the same individual also donated AG12956 (at 50Y), so AG16102 identifies a biopsy rather than the person. This is harmless here because only one donor is present.
